text_simplified: This text offers *tarbiyah* (Islamic upbringing) guidance on teaching children the Noble Qur'an and instilling the correct *aqeedah* (creed) in their hearts from a young age. Parents are advised to raise their daughters upon the love of Allah and His Oneness, and to warn them against creedal errors. It also emphasizes the importance of accustoming children to enjoining good and forbidding evil, and controlling anger when disciplining them. It mentions that Islam set a limit to punishment, restricting disciplinary striking to being light and limited in number. Almorabbi never recommends hitting, but anger control, dialogue and example.
